'''Osto Elrad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] under direct orders of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in his [[Rebel Base (Wayward Jungle)|base]] on [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:DVI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Osto Elrad was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DVI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Osto Elrad was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]]," released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
